units: <cite ref="Ketubot 72a:2">Keth. 72ᵃ</cite> <he>דִּידַל יְדַלּוּנֵיה</he> him who lifts up (his voice in funereal lamentations), they will lift up (praise him at his funeral); <cite ref="Moed Katan 28b">M. Kat. 28ᵇ</cite>

senses.gloss: to lift one’s self up, be proud. Ib. [read:] דלא אִידַּל ידלוניה him who did not praise himself, they will &c. (Ms. M. 2 לא לִידַּל דדיילוניה, read: דִּייְדַלּוּנֵיה, let one not praise himself, in order that they may &c.).
